title: identity.authentication_context_established / identity.step_up_authentication_completed event payload (v1)
description: docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md, section 19d.8 (canon-0.6.0, PACK-07, ADR-026). Produced by epd2_identity_service.events.build_authentication_context_event, shared verbatim by both event_type builders (identity.authentication_context_established, identity.step_up_authentication_completed) - verified by reading application.py, both call the same payload function and differ only in event_type. Deliberately minimal - never includes provider_reference (an opaque infrastructure reference) or any IdentityRecord field (this pack's own task 11 identity-boundary discipline).
